name: tasknotes-core
description: Turbo shim over the TaskNotes shared Rust core — scripts wrap cargo so the workspace participates in the task graph (caching + affected). Same pattern as the scout desktop Rust crate and the Go provider.

scripts.lint: bun ci/vault-reference.ts && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && bun ci/quality-check.ts && cargo run --package xtask -- check-bindings && bun run deny
